title: Martin (PostGIS Vector Tiles) Provider
description: Vector tiles served by Martin from a PostGIS table or function. Best for polygon/point data with dynamic styling and interactivity.

body.source: Martin source name — PostGIS table name or function name. For newly imported tables and views, prefer the stable function source 'ra_vector_tile'.
body.params: Query parameters appended to the tile URL. Canonical managed pattern: {"table": "imported_table_name_or_view"} when source='ra_vector_tile'.
body.styles: Styling object keyed by MVT layer name (usually the table name). Each value is a style rule object.
body.colorRamp: Optional graduated style applied across the layer using a numeric property. When present it is used instead of styles in the frontend.

options.interactive: Boolean, default true. Enables popups on click.
options.maxNativeZoom: Max zoom level tiles are fetched at, default 14.

style_schema.fillColor: CSS color string or hex, e.g. '#3498db'.
style_schema.fillPattern: Optional pattern. Currently only 'hatch' is supported.

colorRamp.description: Graduated color ramp applied to a numeric property.
colorRamp.breaks: Array of numeric breakpoints, length N.
colorRamp.colors: Array of colors (hex or CSS), length N+1.
colorRamp.default: Fallback color for values outside breaks.

conditions.description: Conditional style rules applied to features matching a filter.

Martin with graduated color ramp on a numeric property
Martin using a named PostGIS table directly
Martin layer backed by a view that joins a non-spatial table with a geometry table. Call create_vector_view first, then reference the view name via ra_vector_tile. NEVER put raw SQL in body.source.
setup_steps: 1. Call describe_table on both tables to confirm column names and join keys.
2. Call create_vector_view with name='v_my_join' and a bare SELECT that exposes a geometry column.
3. Create the layer with source='ra_vector_tile' and params.table='v_my_join'.

notes: Martin source 'ra_vector_tile' is a PostGIS function that serves any imported table or ra_vector view via ?table=<name>.
Use the vector_tables/import API endpoint to import a vector file and get a table_name before creating a martin layer.

For layers that join a non-spatial table with geometry, call create_vector_view to create a view in ra_vector first, then use ra_vector_tile with params.table pointing to that view. NEVER put raw SQL in body.source — Martin URL-encodes the source in the tile URL path, causing 404 errors.
Style keys must match the MVT layer name (usually the PostGIS table name).
For interactive popups, ensure interaction_config is also set on the layer.
The backend import flow automatically generates interaction_config from table columns, excluding geometry and housekeeping fields.
For analysis-capable non-COG layers, current validation only allows analysis_type 'histogram'.
